title: OPEN - Proliferated Low-Altitude Detection for C-sUAS
description_text:
SBIR topic DAF26BX06-DP027 (Open); closes 2026-10-21.

Objective

Innovations in Counter-UAS sensor technologies, data processing, and networking to solve the "sneaky drone" problem by improving the detection, tracking, and identification of small, low-altitude, terrain-masked, and RF-silent Group 1-3 UAS. The final system must cost less than $100k at full-rate production.

Description

This DAF focused open topic seeks C-sUAS detect options for transition into the USAF and USSF, specifically supporting AFLCMC/ES and the JIATF 401 marketplace.

title: Novel Radio Frequency Sensing Technologies
description_text:
SBIR topic DPA26BZ06-DV023 (Open); closes 2026-10-21.

Objective

Develop, integrate, and flight-test a high-altitude (=40,000 ft), high-speed (~400 knots) airborne geologic sensing system. The system must be capable of providing rapid, stand-off 3D subsurface tomographic imaging to detect subterranean features such as metals and critical minerals.

Description

Detecting and mapping deep subsurface mineral deposits typically requires localized or low-altitude operations.

title: G-TEAD USAREUR-AF ACE 27-02: Spectrum Enabled Warfare Powered by xTech
description_text:
SBIR topic ARM27BX01-DP001 (Pre-Release); proposals open 2027-04-19; closes 2027-05-07.

Objective

The U.S. Army is seeking innovative electromagnetic spectrum operations solutions from eligible small businesses across the U.S. through the Global Tactical Edge Acquisition Directorate (G-TEAD) Accelerated Capability Event (ACE) 27-02. This platform offers participants the opportunity to engage with the Department of War (DoW), earn prize money and submit a Direct to Phase II Army Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) proposal.

title: ONR Open Topic for Low-Cost Heads Up Displays (HUDs) for Virtual & Augmented Reality (VR/AR)
description_text:
SBIR topic DON27BX01-NP001 (Pre-Release); proposals open 2026-10-28; closes 2026-11-25.

Objective

Develop a commercial technology to address Navy and USMC gaps regarding low-cost, NDAA-compliant heads-up displays (HUDs) with on-board 6 degrees-of-freedom (6DOF) tracking.

Description

ONR requests proposals for existing technology demonstration platforms, prototypes, and commercial products that provide domestically-sourced, low-cost HUDs for first-person view (FPV) drone pilots.
